title: SPLASH
intro: Choose a secret whole-token bid and a permanent name. The lowest unique amount wins.
guest: Open RADA from Telegram to bid, submit a frog or claim a win.
noRound: The first round has not opened yet.
emptyRound: There are no frogs in this SPLASH yet.
roundRule: A round lasts one UTC day, from 00:00 to 24:00 UTC.
roundClosing: This round is closing. Bids reopen in the next round.
bidFor: Place a bid on the frog by {{author}}
bidAmountHint: Enter a whole number of JPEGPE, at least 1.
nameRule: 1 to 32 letters, digits or _, starting with a letter. The name can never change.
nameAvailable: This name is free right now.
nameUnchecked: The name could not be checked. You can still try.
nameRequired: Enter a name for the frog.
promise: A bid is a promise, not a payment: no tokens leave your wallet now. If you win, you pay this amount in JPEGPE when you claim the frog.
burnRule: Pay only if you win, within 24 hours after the round ends, through the platform payment window. Otherwise the frog burns and its name is released.
bidPlacedContested: Your bid is placed. Another bidder in this round proposed the same name.
submitIntro: Add your artwork to the pond. It joins the next round.
submitLimits: PNG, JPEG or WebP. On this device it is converted to PNG, at most 1024 px per side and 2 MB. A solid background is removed after upload. Up to 5 frogs per 24 hours.
submitted: Your frog is in the pond.
backgroundKept: The background was kept: it is not a single solid colour.

prepare.unsupported: This file cannot be used. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
prepare.too_small: This image is too small. Each side needs at least 64 px.
prepare.too_large: This image cannot be made smaller than 2 MB. Choose a simpler image.

unnamedWin: Won frog, name chosen at claim
claimExplain: You pay exactly the winning bid in JPEGPE from a wallet linked to your profile. The RADA payment window shows the amount, recipient and network fee before you confirm.
claimDone: Paid. The frog is now yours.
claimPending: Payment sent. Waiting for the network to confirm it; this can take a few minutes.
claimCancelled: Payment cancelled. You can try again before the deadline.
claimBurned: This frog burned: no payment was confirmed before the deadline.

state.openNote: Claim before the deadline or the frog burns.
state.confirmingNote: A payment was sent but the network has not confirmed it yet. It counts if it landed before the deadline.
state.expiredNote: Claiming is closed. The frog burns unless a payment confirmed before the deadline is found.
state.claimedNote: The frog is in your collection under its permanent name.
state.burnedNote: It was not paid in time. The frog is gone and its name was released.

emptyResults: No frogs were in this round.

error.unavailable: SPLASH is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
error.expired: Your session expired. Reopen RADA from Telegram, then try again.
error.rate_limited: You can submit 5 frogs per 24 hours. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
error.duplicate_image: This image is already in SPLASH.
error.bad_dimensions: Each side must be between 64 and 1024 px.
error.invalid_image: This image could not be read. Try another file.
error.too_large: The image is larger than 2 MB.
error.unsupported_type: Only PNG images can be uploaded.
error.invalid_amount: Enter a whole number of JPEGPE, at least 1.
error.invalid_name: Use 1 to 32 letters, digits or _, starting with a letter.
error.self_bid: You cannot bid on your own frog.
error.not_on_auction: This frog is no longer open for bids.
error.name_taken: This name is already taken. Choose another.
error.not_winner: Only the winner can claim this frog.
error.wallet_not_linked: Link the wallet you pay from in your profile first.
error.wallet_unavailable: Connect a wallet that is linked to your profile, then try again.
error.name_required: Choose a name for the frog.
error.payment_pending: A payment for this frog is still being confirmed.
error.recipient_unset: Claims are not open yet. Try again later.
error.fee_unavailable: The network fee could not be estimated. Try again.
error.fee_expired: The fee estimate expired. Try again.
error.wallet_changed: The connected wallet changed. Try again.

editBidFor: Change your bid on the frog by {{author}}
bidEditHint: Your current bid is {{amount}}. You can change it up or down.
bidRule: The lowest unique whole-number bid wins. Bids are secret. Propose the frog’s name with your bid.
ownFrogNote: Your frog is in play. When the round ends, it will find an owner or enter the archive.
noUniqueRule: Frogs with no unique bid leave the pond.

loadError.bids: Your bids could not be loaded. Try again.
loadError.submissions: Your submissions could not be loaded. Try again.
loadError.claims: Your wins could not be loaded. Try again.
loadError.history: The chronicle could not be loaded. Try again.

bidIntro: If your number is the lowest among those nobody repeated, the frog is yours.
bidPaymentNote: Pay only if you win: within 24 hours after the finish. Only you can see your bids.
